entry.name: Mozilla Firefox (CentOS 6 package)
entry.verified: CentOS 6 package: rpm -K OK (CentOS 6 key c105b9de in the system rpmdb) on firefox and its 50 dependency rpms from vault.centos.org/6.10/{os,updates}, dependency closure computed from the repo's primary.xml against the VM's installed provides; geckodriver .tar.gz.asc verified with the same Mozilla release key (subkey 09BEED63F3462A2DFFAB3B875ECB6497C1A20256)
entry.notes: driver is a wrapper that sources ~/ibbrowsers/env.sh (LD_LIBRARY_PATH -> ~/ibbrowsers/sysroot, FONTCONFIG_FILE -> ~/ibbrowsers/fonts.conf) then execs the real driver next to it; env.sh also adds sysroot/usr/lib64/firefox/bundled/lib64 (the package's own bundled gtk3). Mozilla's official builds don't run here: every one checked (52.9.0esr ... 156.0) needs libstdc++ GLIBCXX_3.4.15/CXXABI_1.3.5 (CentOS 6 has gcc 4.4.7: 3.4.13); 78+ also need GLIBC_2.14-2.17. Tried 68.12.0esr: ldd 'version `CXXABI_1.3.5' not found', 'version `GLIBCXX_3.4.15' not found' (and libgtk-3.so.0 missing). geckodriver 0.37.1 officially targets Firefox >=128 but the smoke passed with 78.5.0. geckodriver: forward with the SAME local port as the remote --port (geckodriver rejects a Host header whose port differs: 'Invalid Host header 127.0.0.1:<otherport>').
